shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo ---- && find .agents -type f | head -100 && echo ---- && ls -la && cat package.json && cat AGENTS.md

find src -type f | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "=== {}"; cat {}' && echo "=== index.html" && cat index.html && echo "=== tsconfig" && cat tsconfig.json && echo "=== vite" && cat vite.config.ts && echo "=== .gitignore" && cat .gitignore && ls __agent_eval__ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head

sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ----TRAPS; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo ----ICONS; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head -3; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/hooks | tr '\n' ' '

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm 2>/dev/null | head && bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Button Avatar Flex Box Text Card useFileInput Icon Divider 2>&1 | head -80; echo ----ONLINE; curl -sS -m 20 -o /tmp/uikit7.md -w "%{http_code} %{size_download}\n" https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt; head -c 300 /tmp/uikit7.md

node -e 'fetch("https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt",{signal:AbortSignal.timeout(20000)}).then(async r=>{const t=await r.text();require("fs").writeFileSync("/tmp/uikit7.md",t);console.log(r.status,t.length,r.headers.get("content-type"))}).catch(e=>console.log("ERR",e.message))'; echo ----DTS; E=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $E/components/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts $E/components/Select/types.d.ts $E/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts $E/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts $E/components/Avatar/types.d.ts $E/hooks/useFileInput/useFileInput.d.ts $E/components/controls/types.d.ts 2>&1 | grep -v '^$' | head -260

E=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; echo ==TextInput; ls $E/components/controls/TextInput/; grep -v '^$' $E/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | sed -n 1,60p; echo ==ControlProps; grep -n -A12 'export interface ControlProps' $E/components/types.d.ts; grep -n -A6 'ControlGroupOption' $E/components/types.d.ts | head -20; echo ==Avatar; ls $E/components/Avatar/; grep -v '^$' $E/components/Avatar/types.d.ts $E/components/Avatar/Avatar.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo ==Card; grep -v '^$' $E/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -30; echo ==Divider; grep -v '^$' $E/components/Divider/Divider.d.ts | head -20; echo ==Button; grep -n -B2 -A30 'export interface ButtonProps' $E/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -50; echo ==Text; grep -n 'variant\|color' $E/components/Text/Text.d.ts $E/components/Text/text/text.d.ts $E/components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo ==ONLINE-toc; grep -n '^#' /tmp/uikit7.md | head -80; echo ==LAYOUT; grep -n -i 'gap\|direction\|spacing\|Flex\b' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/layout.md | head -60

E=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; echo ==AvatarTypes; cat $E/components/Avatar/types/*.d.ts | grep -v '^$' | head -70; echo ==Button; grep -v '^$' $E/components/Button/Button.d.ts | sed -n 1,60p; echo ==Flex; grep -v '^$' $E/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | sed -n 1,80p; echo ==Box; grep -v '^$' $E/components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts | sed -n 1,60p; echo ==TextVariants; grep -n -A20 'TEXT_VARIANTS' $E/components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -30; grep -rn 'TEXT_VARIANTS\s*=' $E/components/Text/ | head -3; grep -n -A12 'TEXT_COLORS\s*=' $E/components/Text/colorText/*.js | head -15; echo ==Pitfalls; sed -n 28,40p /tmp/uikit7.md; echo ==Hooks; sed -n 181,230p /tmp/uikit7.md | grep -i 'file\|Form\|FormRow' ; grep -n -i 'FormRow\|FileInput\|useFileInput' /tmp/uikit7.md | head

E=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; grep -v '^$' $E/components/Avatar/AvatarImage/types.d.ts $E/components/Avatar/AvatarText/types.d.ts $E/components/Avatar/AvatarIcon/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -50; echo ==Icon; grep -v '^$' $E/components/Icon/Icon.d.ts | head -30; echo ==icons; cd node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons && for n in ArrowUpFromSquare TrashBin Xmark Check Person Camera; do [ -f "$n.d.ts" ] && echo "OK $n" || echo "MISSING $n"; done; ls | grep -i 'upload\|trash\|camera\|person\b' | head

sed -i "s|<Box as=\"main\" maxWidth={640} width=\"100%\" spacing={{mx: 'auto', px: 4, py: 6}}>|<Box as=\"main\" maxWidth={640} width=\"100%\" spacing={{px: 4, py: 6}} style={{marginInline: 'auto'}}>|" src/ProfileSettingsPage.tsx && grep -n 'as="main"' src/ProfileSettingsPage.tsx && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15
